description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and is used to check for duplicate test case names within a test management system. It initializes the page, checks user rights, and verifies whether a test case name already exists to prevent duplicates. The script outputs a JSON response indicating success or failure along with a message.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class managing hierarchical node structures, such as test cases and test suites, with methods for checking node existence and retrieving node types.

methods.name: nodeNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a node with a given name exists within specified criteria, returning status and message.

methods.name: get_available_node_types
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available node types, such as 'testcase'.
